changes.what: Rewrote botShoot to fire a real, dodgeable soak projectile from the bot's own TOOLS loadout via c.projectiles.spawn (damage = stats.soak), removing the dead hitscan WEAPON/traceShot carbine path. Gated firing on the bot's Charge.
changes.why: D1 gate: bots must use the same soak kit as the player so the PvP loop is observable and the BOTH-weapons fantasy holds; also unifies hit resolution through Projectiles.

changes.what: Gave tactical bots a randomized soak loadout + Charge in _styleBot; passed the mode's Projectiles pool into the bot-brain ctx; stepped each bot's Charge per frame; and let the host resolve bot-owned projectile hits in _onProjectileHit (ownedByHostBot check).
changes.why: D1: feed the bot a real loadout, wire the pool through, and make bot projectiles actually deal soak damage on the host (offline and online host) instead of only drawing them.

changes.what: Deleted dead hitscan code (WEAPON, Magazine, buildViewModel, traceShot, raySphere); kept only the shared applySpread helper.
changes.why: D1 acceptance: Magazine/buildViewModel must be deletable without breaking the build; the hitscan carbine only fed the bot and is now fully replaced by Projectiles.
